# Precursor ruins (doc 68, section 6). Province scope unless said. Plain ifs only (Claude files/35).

DA_RX_toggle = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_province_flag = DA_RX_open }
		clr_province_flag = DA_RX_open
		set_province_flag = DA_RX_was_open
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_province_flag = DA_RX_was_open } }
		set_province_flag = DA_RX_open
		clr_province_flag = DA_LE_open
		clr_province_flag = DA_HX_open
		FROM = {
			clr_country_flag = DA_province_mega_engineering_open
			clr_country_flag = DA_province_medicine_open
			clr_country_flag = DA_province_fortifications_open
		}
	}
	clr_province_flag = DA_RX_was_open
}

# The AI: the Wayfarers, ducats only (doc 68, section 14)
DA_RX_ai_send = {
	if = {
		limit = { is_variable_equal = { which = DA_RX_ring value = 0 } }
		owner = { add_treasury = -50 }
		add_province_modifier = { name = DA_RX_party duration = 45 }
		set_variable = { which = DA_RX_reps value = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { is_variable_equal = { which = DA_RX_ring value = 1 } }
		owner = { add_treasury = -100 }
		add_province_modifier = { name = DA_RX_party duration = 60 }
		set_variable = { which = DA_RX_reps value = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { is_variable_equal = { which = DA_RX_ring value = 2 } }
		owner = { add_treasury = -200 }
		add_province_modifier = { name = DA_RX_party duration = 75 }
		set_variable = { which = DA_RX_reps value = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { is_variable_equal = { which = DA_RX_ring value = 3 } }
		owner = { add_treasury = -400 }
		add_province_modifier = { name = DA_RX_party duration = 90 }
		set_variable = { which = DA_RX_reps value = 2 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { is_variable_equal = { which = DA_RX_ring value = 4 } }
		owner = { add_treasury = -800 }
		add_province_modifier = { name = DA_RX_party duration = 105 }
		set_variable = { which = DA_RX_reps value = 2 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { is_variable_equal = { which = DA_RX_ring value = 5 } }
		owner = { add_treasury = -1600 }
		add_province_modifier = { name = DA_RX_party duration = 120 }
		set_variable = { which = DA_RX_reps value = 2 }
	}
	clr_province_flag = DA_RX_ch.wardbreakers
	clr_province_flag = DA_RX_ch.relics
	clr_province_flag = DA_RX_ch.glyphs
	set_province_flag = DA_RX_out
	clr_province_flag = DA_RX_failed
	owner = { change_variable = { which = DA_RX_parties value = 1 } set_country_flag = DA_RX_any_out }
}
# A find's mark on the ring being worked on
DA_RX_mark = {
	if = {
		limit = { is_variable_equal = { which = DA_RX_ring value = 0 } }
		set_province_flag = DA_RX_m1_$kind$
	}
	if = {
		limit = { is_variable_equal = { which = DA_RX_ring value = 1 } }
		set_province_flag = DA_RX_m2_$kind$
	}
	if = {
		limit = { is_variable_equal = { which = DA_RX_ring value = 2 } }
		set_province_flag = DA_RX_m3_$kind$
	}
	if = {
		limit = { is_variable_equal = { which = DA_RX_ring value = 3 } }
		set_province_flag = DA_RX_m4_$kind$
	}
	if = {
		limit = { is_variable_equal = { which = DA_RX_ring value = 4 } }
		set_province_flag = DA_RX_m5_$kind$
	}
	if = {
		limit = { is_variable_equal = { which = DA_RX_ring value = 5 } }
		set_province_flag = DA_RX_m6_$kind$
	}
}
# Every report: Precursor Lore by band, for a people of the Precursor heritage
DA_RX_report_lore = {
	if = {
		limit = { is_variable_equal = { which = DA_RX_ring value = 0 } owner = { DA_EL_heritage = yes } }
		owner = { DA_EL_add_lore = { amount = 1 } }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { is_variable_equal = { which = DA_RX_ring value = 1 } owner = { DA_EL_heritage = yes } }
		owner = { DA_EL_add_lore = { amount = 1 } }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { is_variable_equal = { which = DA_RX_ring value = 2 } owner = { DA_EL_heritage = yes } }
		owner = { DA_EL_add_lore = { amount = 2 } }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { is_variable_equal = { which = DA_RX_ring value = 3 } owner = { DA_EL_heritage = yes } }
		owner = { DA_EL_add_lore = { amount = 2 } }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { is_variable_equal = { which = DA_RX_ring value = 4 } owner = { DA_EL_heritage = yes } }
		owner = { DA_EL_add_lore = { amount = 3 } }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { is_variable_equal = { which = DA_RX_ring value = 5 } owner = { DA_EL_heritage = yes } }
		owner = { DA_EL_add_lore = { amount = 3 } }
	}
}

DA_RX_band_gold = {
	if = {
		limit = { is_variable_equal = { which = DA_RX_ring value = 0 } }
		owner = { add_treasury = 50 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { is_variable_equal = { which = DA_RX_ring value = 1 } }
		owner = { add_treasury = 50 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { is_variable_equal = { which = DA_RX_ring value = 2 } }
		owner = { add_treasury = 100 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { is_variable_equal = { which = DA_RX_ring value = 3 } }
		owner = { add_treasury = 100 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { is_variable_equal = { which = DA_RX_ring value = 4 } }
		owner = { add_treasury = 150 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { is_variable_equal = { which = DA_RX_ring value = 5 } }
		owner = { add_treasury = 150 }
	}
}
# Lore for a people of the Precursor heritage; anyone else takes prestige from what it cannot read
DA_RX_gain = {
	if = {
		limit = { owner = { DA_EL_heritage = yes } }
		owner = { DA_EL_add_lore = { amount = $lore$ } }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { owner = { NOT = { DA_EL_heritage = yes } } }
		owner = { add_prestige = $prestige$ }
	}
}
# After a report: the next one in ten days; after the last, the ring is unsealed (unless the expedition withdrew)
DA_RX_after_report = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { which = DA_RX_reps value = 1 }
			NOT = { has_province_flag = DA_RX_failed }
		}
		set_province_flag = DA_RX_reporting
		province_event = { id = DA_RX_event.1 days = 10 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { check_variable = { which = DA_RX_reps value = 1 } }
			NOT = { has_province_flag = DA_RX_failed }
		}
		DA_RX_unseal = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				has_province_flag = DA_RX_failed
				NOT = { check_variable = { which = DA_RX_reps value = 1 } }
			}
		}
		DA_RX_end = yes
	}
}
DA_RX_end = {
	clr_province_flag = DA_RX_out
	clr_province_flag = DA_RX_failed
	clr_province_flag = DA_RX_guided_here
	set_variable = { which = DA_RX_reps value = 0 }
	remove_province_modifier = DA_RX_party
	owner = { change_variable = { which = DA_RX_parties value = -1 } }
}
# A ring is unsealed: its codex at ring III, the deepest ring of the owner, the great ruins at ring IV and VI.
# DA_LZ (doc 73): a stratum of a lizardfolk city is dug (DA_RX_lz_dug and its own report)
DA_RX_unseal = {
	change_variable = { which = DA_RX_ring value = 1 }
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { DA_RX_lz = yes } }
		province_event = { id = DA_RX_event.2 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { DA_RX_lz = yes }
		DA_RX_lz_dug = yes
		province_event = { id = DA_RX_event.149 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { is_variable_equal = { which = DA_RX_ring value = 1 } NOT = { DA_RX_lz = yes } }
		owner = {
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { which = DA_EL_ring_max value = 1 } } }
				set_variable = { which = DA_EL_ring_max value = 1 }
			}
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { is_variable_equal = { which = DA_RX_ring value = 2 } NOT = { DA_RX_lz = yes } }
		owner = {
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { which = DA_EL_ring_max value = 2 } } }
				set_variable = { which = DA_EL_ring_max value = 2 }
			}
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { is_variable_equal = { which = DA_RX_ring value = 3 } NOT = { DA_RX_lz = yes } }
		owner = {
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { which = DA_EL_ring_max value = 3 } } }
				set_variable = { which = DA_EL_ring_max value = 3 }
			}
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { is_variable_equal = { which = DA_RX_ring value = 4 } NOT = { DA_RX_lz = yes } }
		owner = {
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { which = DA_EL_ring_max value = 4 } } }
				set_variable = { which = DA_EL_ring_max value = 4 }
			}
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { is_variable_equal = { which = DA_RX_ring value = 5 } NOT = { DA_RX_lz = yes } }
		owner = {
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { which = DA_EL_ring_max value = 5 } } }
				set_variable = { which = DA_EL_ring_max value = 5 }
			}
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { is_variable_equal = { which = DA_RX_ring value = 6 } NOT = { DA_RX_lz = yes } }
		owner = {
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { which = DA_EL_ring_max value = 6 } } }
				set_variable = { which = DA_EL_ring_max value = 6 }
			}
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { DA_RX_great = yes is_variable_equal = { which = DA_RX_ring value = 4 } NOT = { has_province_flag = DA_RX_g4 } }
		set_province_flag = DA_RX_g4
		owner = { change_variable = { which = DA_EL_great4 value = 1 } }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { DA_RX_great = yes is_variable_equal = { which = DA_RX_ring value = 6 } }
		owner = { set_country_flag = DA_EL_great6 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { is_variable_equal = { which = DA_RX_ring value = 3 } owner = { DA_EL_heritage = yes } }
		if = {
			limit = { province_id = 945 }
			owner = { DA_EL_give_codex.transmutation = yes }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { province_id = 932 }
			owner = { DA_EL_give_codex.enchantment = yes }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { province_id = 1068 }
			owner = { DA_EL_give_codex.abjuration = yes }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { province_id = 2497 }
			owner = { DA_EL_give_codex.conjuration = yes }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { province_id = 2112 }
			owner = { DA_EL_give_codex.conjuration = yes }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { province_id = 2745 }
			owner = { DA_EL_give_codex.divination = yes }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { province_id = 2201 }
			owner = { DA_EL_give_codex.transmutation = yes }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { province_id = 2520 }
			owner = { DA_EL_give_codex.necromancy = yes }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { province_id = 2023 }
			owner = { DA_EL_give_codex.illusion = yes }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { province_id = 1948 }
			owner = { DA_EL_give_codex.necromancy = yes }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { province_id = 1044 }
			owner = { DA_EL_give_codex.abjuration = yes }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { province_id = 1201 }
			owner = { DA_EL_give_codex.evocation = yes }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_province_modifier = the_glowing_city }
			owner = { DA_EL_give_codex.transmutation = yes }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_province_modifier = the_dragon_house }
			owner = { DA_EL_give_codex.evocation = yes }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_province_modifier = elfenbride_manse }
			owner = { DA_EL_give_codex.illusion = yes }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_province_modifier = god_fragment_ruins }
			owner = { DA_EL_give_codex.fragment = yes }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_province_modifier = vault_ruins }
			owner = { DA_EL_give_codex.necromancy = yes }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_province_modifier = portal_nexus }
			owner = { DA_EL_give_codex.conjuration = yes }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_province_modifier = floating_city_crash_site }
			owner = { DA_EL_give_codex.transmutation = yes }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { DA_RX_temple_rings = yes NOT = { DA_RX_corrupt = yes } }
			owner = { DA_EL_give_codex.conjuration = yes }
		}
	}
	owner = { DA_RX_count = yes }
}
# Country scope: the ruins of ours with a ring unsealed (not the lizardfolk strata)
DA_RX_count = {
	set_variable = { which = DA_RX_open value = 0 }
	every_owned_province = {
		limit = { check_variable = { which = DA_RX_ring value = 1 } NOT = { DA_RX_lz = yes } }
		owner = { change_variable = { which = DA_RX_open value = 1 } }
	}
}
# Country scope, monthly: an expedition whose time is up sends its first report
DA_RX_monthly = {
	clr_country_flag = DA_RX_any_out
	every_owned_province = {
		limit = { has_province_flag = DA_RX_out }
		owner = { set_country_flag = DA_RX_any_out }
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_province_modifier = DA_RX_party }
				NOT = { has_province_flag = DA_RX_reporting }
			}
			set_province_flag = DA_RX_reporting
			province_event = { id = DA_RX_event.1 }
		}
	}
}
# Open a Waygate (Conjuration III): a great ruin of ours unsealed to ring IV
DA_RX_waygate = {
	owner = {
		add_treasury = -500
		DA_EL_pay_lore = { amount = 10 }
		if = {
			limit = { ai = no }
			DA_EL_pay_mana = { amount = 20 }
		}
		hidden_effect = { change_variable = { which = DA_EL_waygates value = 1 } }
	}
	add_permanent_province_modifier = { name = DA_RX_waygate duration = -1 }
	set_province_flag = DA_RX_waygate
}

# ---- Surveys abroad (doc 72). Country scope. ----
# Open the chooser (from the Archive's Ruin Expeditions plate, or the Workshop's Precursor view)
DA_RX_open_survey = {
	country_event = { id = DA_RX_event.60 }
}
# The price, the first ring, the cooldown of the site (DA_RX_sv_site)
DA_RX_sv_start = {
	if = {
		limit = { DA_EL_heritage = yes }
		add_treasury = -150
		if = {
			limit = { ai = no DA_EL_is_ruinborn = yes }
			DA_EL_pay_mana = { amount = 3 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { ai = no NOT = { DA_EL_is_ruinborn = yes } }
			DA_EL_pay_mana = { amount = 5 }
		}
		hidden_effect = { set_variable = { which = DA_RX_sv_max value = 2 } }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { DA_EL_heritage = yes } }
		add_treasury = -350
		hidden_effect = { set_variable = { which = DA_RX_sv_max value = 3 } }

# After a report: the next ring, or home (also when the survey is called home)
DA_RX_sv_after = {
	clr_country_flag = DA_RX_sv_reporting
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_RX_sv_home }
			NOT = { check_variable = { which = DA_RX_sv_ring which = DA_RX_sv_max } }
		}
		change_variable = { which = DA_RX_sv_ring value = 1 }
		if = { limit = { is_variable_equal = { which = DA_RX_sv_ring value = 2 } } add_country_modifier = { name = DA_RX_surveying duration = 60 } }
		if = { limit = { is_variable_equal = { which = DA_RX_sv_ring value = 3 } } add_country_modifier = { name = DA_RX_surveying duration = 75 } }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				has_country_flag = DA_RX_sv_home
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = DA_RX_surveying }
			}
		}
		clr_country_flag = DA_RX_sv_out
		clr_country_flag = DA_RX_sv_home
		remove_country_modifier = DA_RX_surveying
		country_event = { id = DA_RX_event.63 days = 1 }
	}
}
# Relic samples for the Workshop (province scope: an expedition of a gnomish country with Gommo Surveys)
DA_RX_gn_samples = {
	if = {
		limit = { owner = { NOT = { DA_EL_heritage = yes } DA_GN_surveys = yes } is_variable_equal = { which = DA_RX_ring value = 2 } }
		owner = { DA_RX_add_samples = { amount = 2 } }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { owner = { NOT = { DA_EL_heritage = yes } DA_GN_surveys = yes } NOT = { is_variable_equal = { which = DA_RX_ring value = 2 } } }
		owner = { DA_RX_add_samples = { amount = 1 } }
	}
}
# Country scope: relic samples, shown as a plain line (doc 66)
DA_RX_add_samples = {
	custom_tooltip = DA_RX_samples_tt.$amount$
	hidden_effect = { change_variable = { which = DA_GN_samples value = $amount$ } }
}

# ---- The lizardfolk strata (doc 73). Province scope. ----
# A stratum dug: the deepest stratum the owner has dug (the hall's level III), Kazakesh VI and Arskitse IV
DA_RX_lz_dug = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			is_variable_equal = { which = DA_RX_ring value = 1 }
			owner = { NOT = { check_variable = { which = DA_LZ_stratum_max value = 1 } } }
		}
		owner = { set_variable = { which = DA_LZ_stratum_max value = 1 } }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			is_variable_equal = { which = DA_RX_ring value = 2 }
			owner = { NOT = { check_variable = { which = DA_LZ_stratum_max value = 2 } } }
		}
		owner = { set_variable = { which = DA_LZ_stratum_max value = 2 } }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			is_variable_equal = { which = DA_RX_ring value = 3 }
			owner = { NOT = { check_variable = { which = DA_LZ_stratum_max value = 3 } } }
		}
		owner = { set_variable = { which = DA_LZ_stratum_max value = 3 } }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			is_variable_equal = { which = DA_RX_ring value = 4 }
			owner = { NOT = { check_variable = { which = DA_LZ_stratum_max value = 4 } } }
		}
		owner = { set_variable = { which = DA_LZ_stratum_max value = 4 } }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			is_variable_equal = { which = DA_RX_ring value = 5 }
			owner = { NOT = { check_variable = { which = DA_LZ_stratum_max value = 5 } } }
		}
		owner = { set_variable = { which = DA_LZ_stratum_max value = 5 } }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			is_variable_equal = { which = DA_RX_ring value = 6 }
			owner = { NOT = { check_variable = { which = DA_LZ_stratum_max value = 6 } } }
		}
		owner = { set_variable = { which = DA_LZ_stratum_max value = 6 } }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { province_id = 5763 check_variable = { which = DA_RX_ring value = 6 } }
		owner = { set_country_flag = DA_LZ_dug.kazakesh_6 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { province_id = 6032 check_variable = { which = DA_RX_ring value = 4 } }
		owner = { set_country_flag = DA_LZ_dug.arskitse_4 }
	}
}
# Every report of a lizardfolk country steadies its memory: +1 Clarity for five years
DA_RX_report_lz = {
	if = {
		limit = { owner = { DA_LZ_heritage = yes } }
		owner = {
			custom_tooltip = DA_RX_report_lz_tt
			hidden_effect = {
				add_country_modifier = { name = DA_LZ_clar_report duration = 1825 }
				DA_LZ_refresh = yes
			}
		}
	}
}

	}
}
# A Fossil Clutch (in the hidden roll): its ancient trait by the stratum's empire, any of the four elsewhere
DA_RX_lz_fossil = {
	owner = { DA_LZ_pick_ancient = yes }
	if = {
		limit = { DA_RX_lz_at.e271 = yes }
		owner = {
			clr_country_flag = DA_LZ_next_anc.golden
			clr_country_flag = DA_LZ_next_anc.spire
			clr_country_flag = DA_LZ_next_anc.araizary
			clr_country_flag = DA_LZ_next_anc.desert
			set_country_flag = DA_LZ_next_anc.golden
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { DA_RX_lz_at.e1 = yes }
		owner = {
			clr_country_flag = DA_LZ_next_anc.golden
			clr_country_flag = DA_LZ_next_anc.spire
			clr_country_flag = DA_LZ_next_anc.araizary
			clr_country_flag = DA_LZ_next_anc.desert
			set_country_flag = DA_LZ_next_anc.spire
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { DA_RX_lz_at.e2 = yes }
		owner = {
			clr_country_flag = DA_LZ_next_anc.golden
			clr_country_flag = DA_LZ_next_anc.spire
			clr_country_flag = DA_LZ_next_anc.araizary
			clr_country_flag = DA_LZ_next_anc.desert
			set_country_flag = DA_LZ_next_anc.araizary
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { DA_RX_lz_at.genie = yes }
		owner = {
			clr_country_flag = DA_LZ_next_anc.golden
			clr_country_flag = DA_LZ_next_anc.spire
			clr_country_flag = DA_LZ_next_anc.araizary
			clr_country_flag = DA_LZ_next_anc.desert
			set_country_flag = DA_LZ_next_anc.desert
		}
	}
}
# The fossil clutch kept for the next clutch: one trait more on offer (DA_LZ_hatch)
DA_RX_lz_keep_fossil = {
	owner = {
		custom_tooltip = DA_RX_lz_keep_fossil_tt
		hidden_effect = {
			set_country_flag = DA_LZ_fossil_kept
			clr_country_flag = DA_LZ_next_anc.golden
			clr_country_flag = DA_LZ_next_anc.spire
			clr_country_flag = DA_LZ_next_anc.araizary
			clr_country_flag = DA_LZ_next_anc.desert
		}
	}
}
# Deep Devil Eggs: the gallery flooded, no dig here for twenty years
DA_RX_lz_flood = {
	custom_tooltip = DA_RX_lz_flood_tt
	hidden_effect = {
		add_province_modifier = { name = DA_RX_lz_flooded duration = 7300 }
		set_province_flag = DA_RX_failed
	}
}
# The Deep Devil of Arskitse (le_rules.py): the first eggs show it, the second open the way to it
DA_RX_lz_eggs = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_province_flag = DA_LZ_eggs1 }
		set_province_flag = DA_LZ_eggs2
	}
	set_province_flag = DA_LZ_eggs1
}
# Tchazara's Trail: the first wakes her, the second opens the way to her (le_rules.py)
DA_RX_lz_trail = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_flag = DA_LZ_tchazara_awake }
		custom_tooltip = DA_RX_lz_trail2_tt
		hidden_effect = { set_global_flag = DA_LZ_tchazara_trail2 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_flag = DA_LZ_tchazara_awake } }
		owner = { DA_LZ_wake_tchazara = yes }
	}
}
